title: ...harden your computer privacy and security
desc: Minimize data tracking, telemetry, and vulnerability vectors.
todos: Install open-source content blocker (uBlock Origin) in browser.
Disable OS background telemetry, diagnostic tracking, and location services.
Switch default browser search engine to privacy-focused service (DuckDuckGo/Brave).
Audit and revoke unnecessary camera and microphone app permissions.
Configure DNS-over-HTTPS (DoH) inside web browser security settings.
